# Documentation templates

Use these templates for subjects that now need a durable reference. Do not generate empty feature or runbook files to fill a directory tree.

- [Feature](feature.md): outcome, rules, transitions, contracts and acceptance.
- [Decision](decision.md): context, actual alternatives, consequences and revisit conditions.
- [Runbook](runbook.md): preconditions, safe actions, verification and reversal limits.

Replace all placeholders. Use Proposed until the described decision or behavior is accepted/implemented. Record verification only after inspecting the relevant source or executing the procedure, and name that scope. Link to authoritative contracts instead of copying large schemas.
